meta.title: Savda — Discover what Cambodia makes
meta.description: Savda is a discovery platform for Cambodian-made products, creators, and the stories behind them.

hero.title: Discover what Cambodia makes.
hero.body: Savda is a platform that tells the stories behind Cambodian-made products — the people, the craft, and the ideas most people haven't heard of yet.

items.caption: A ceramics studio reviving Khmer glazing techniques
A small-batch coffee roaster from Mondulkiri
A weaving collective preserving traditional patterns
An independent furniture designer working with rattan
A perfumer sourcing botanicals from the countryside
A leather workshop based in Phnom Penh

stories.title: Good products deserve to be discovered.
stories.subtitle: Good creators deserve to be known.
stories.body: Savda isn't just cataloguing products. It tells the stories of the people who make them — the craftsmanship, the process, and the ideas behind every piece.

madeInCambodia.title: Made in Cambodia, worth knowing.
madeInCambodia.body: There are Cambodian products you haven't heard of yet — and Cambodian-made doesn't have to mean cheap alternative. It can mean design, craftsmanship, innovation, quality, culture, and originality.

creators.title: You make it. We tell the story.
creators.body: Savda helps Cambodian creators get discovered by new audiences, and gives interested people a way to purchase their products — without creators needing to become experts in content marketing.

follow.title: Keep discovering.
follow.body: Follow Savda for Cambodian products, creators, and stories worth knowing.
